1: // Meteor Dodge game with improved graphics and sounds
2: const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
3: const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
4: // Audio context and sound effects
5: const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
6: function playTone(freq, duration) {
7:   const oscillator = audioCtx.createOscillator();
8:   const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
9:   oscillator.type = 'sine';
10:   oscillator.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, audioCtx.currentTime);
11:   oscillator.connect(gain);
12:   gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
13:   gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
14:   oscillator.start();
15:   oscillator.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
16: }
17: function playShoot() { playTone(400, 0.1); }
18: function playExplosion() { playTone(100, 0.3); }
19: 
20: canvas.width = 800;
21: canvas.height = 600;
22: 
23: // Background stars
24: const stars = [];
25: const starCount = 100;
26: for (let i = 0; i < starCount; i++) {
27:   stars.push({
28:     x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
29:     y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
30:     radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
31:     alpha: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.5,
32:   });
33: }
34: 
35: // Ship (triangle)
36: const ship = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height - 40, width: 40, height: 30, speed: 5 };
37: let left = false,
38:   right = false,
39:   shoot = false;
40: 
41: // Bullets (circles)
42: const bullets = [];
43: const bulletSpeed = 7;
44: 
45: // Meteors (circles with gradient)
46: const meteors = [];
47: const meteorMinSpeed = 2,
48:   meteorMaxSpeed = 5;
49: let spawnTimer = 0;
50: const spawnInterval = 60; // frames
51: let score = 0;
52: 
53: function keyDown(e) {
54:   if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') left = true;
55:   if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') right = true;
56:   if (e.key === ' ') shoot = true;
57: }
58: function keyUp(e) {
59:   if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') left = false;
60:   if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') right = false;
61:   if (e.key === ' ') shoot = false;
62: }
63: window.addEventListener('keydown', keyDown);
64: window.addEventListener('keyup', keyUp);
65: 
66: function spawnMeteor() {
67:   const size = 30 + Math.random() * 20;
68:   meteors.push({
69:     x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - size),
70:     y: -size,
71:     radius: size / 2,
72:     speed: meteorMinSpeed + Math.random() * (meteorMaxSpeed - meteorMinSpeed),
73:   });
74: }
75: 
76: function update() {
77:   // Ship movement
78:   if (left) ship.x -= ship.speed;
79:   if (right) ship.x += ship.speed;
80:   ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.width, ship.x));
81: 
82:   // Shooting
83:   if (shoot) {
84:     // rate limit: one bullet per 15px travel
85:     if (bullets.length === 0 || bullets[bullets.length - 1].y < ship.y - 15) {
86:       bullets.push({ x: ship.x + ship.width / 2, y: ship.y, radius: 4 });
87:     playShoot();
88:     }
89:   }
90: 
91:   // Update bullets
92:   for (let i = bullets.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
93:     bullets[i].y -= bulletSpeed;
94:     if (bullets[i].y < 0) bullets.splice(i, 1);
95:   }
96: 
97:   // Spawn meteors
98:   if (spawnTimer <= 0) {
99:     spawnMeteor();
100:     spawnTimer = spawnInterval;
101:   } else {
102:     spawnTimer--;
103:   }
104: 
105:   // Update meteors and handle collisions
106:   for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
107:     const m = meteors[i];
108:     m.y += m.speed;
109: 
110:     // Collision with ship
111:     if (
112:       m.x < ship.x + ship.width &&
113:       m.x + m.radius * 2 > ship.x &&
114:       m.y < ship.y + ship.height &&
115:       m.y + m.radius * 2 > ship.y
116:     ) {
117:       alert('Game Over! Score: ' + score);
118:       document.location.reload();
119:     }
120: 
121:     // Collision with bullets
122:     for (let j = bullets.length - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
123:       const b = bullets[j];
124:       const dx = b.x - (m.x + m.radius);
125:       const dy = b.y - (m.y + m.radius);
126:       const distance = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
127: if (distance < m.radius + b.radius) {
128:           // meteor hit
129:           playExplosion();
130:           meteors.splice(i, 1);
131:           bullets.splice(j, 1);
132:           score++;
133:           break;
134:         }
135:     }
136: 
137:     // Remove off‑screen meteors
138:     if (m.y - m.radius > canvas.height) meteors.splice(i, 1);
139:   }
140: }
141: 
142: function drawStar(star) {
143:   ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255,255,255,${star.alpha})`;
144:   ctx.beginPath();
145:   ctx.arc(star.x, star.y, star.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
146:   ctx.fill();
147: }
148: 
149: function drawShip() {
150:   ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
151:   ctx.beginPath();
152:   ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.height);
153:   ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.width / 2, ship.y);
154:   ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.width, ship.y + ship.height);
155:   ctx.closePath();
156:   ctx.fill();
157: }
158: 
159: function drawBullet(b) {
160:   ctx.fillStyle = 'yellow';
161:   ctx.beginPath();
162:   ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
163:   ctx.fill();
164: }
165: 
166: function drawMeteor(m) {
167:   const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(
168:     m.x + m.radius,
169:     m.y + m.radius,
170:     m.radius * 0.2,
171:     m.x + m.radius,
172:     m.y + m.radius,
173:     m.radius
174:   );
175:   gradient.addColorStop(0, '#ff8c00'); // bright core
176:   gradient.addColorStop(1, '#8b0000'); // dark edge
177:   ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
178:   ctx.beginPath();
179:   ctx.arc(m.x + m.radius, m.y + m.radius, m.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
180:   ctx.fill();
181: }
182: 
183: function draw() {
184:   // Clear background (black space)
185:   ctx.fillStyle = 'black';
186:   ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
187: 
188:   // Stars
189:   stars.forEach(drawStar);
190: 
191:   // Ship
192:   drawShip();
193: 
194:   // Bullets
195:   bullets.forEach(drawBullet);
196: 
197:   // Meteors
198:   meteors.forEach(drawMeteor);
199: 
200:   // Score text
201:   ctx.fillStyle = 'white';
202:   ctx.font = '20px Arial';
203:   ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 30);
204: }
205: 
206: function loop() {
207:   update();
208:   draw();
209:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
210: }
211: loop();
